definitions: A library built on top of LangChain for building robust and stateful multi-actor applications with LLMs.
A framework designed to create agentic applications by modeling steps as nodes in a graph, allowing for complex chains of operations and human-in-the-loop workflows.
examples: LangGraph enables the creation of cyclical agent runtimes.
Developers use LangGraph to manage conversational states.
The latest update to LangGraph includes new graph visualization tools.
